guide.description: A humming plate with sand on it. Every note shakes the sand into a figure of its own, and the note you hear is the one that draws it.

controls.action: Change the note. The sand lets go and gathers into a new figure.
Scatter the sand and watch it gather again.
Hear the note that draws the figure.
Keep this mode sounding and find a second one with the knobs: the two figures and the two notes are laid over each other. Press again to let it go.
Drive: how hard the plate shakes. More gathers the sand faster into finer lines; at 0% it lies still.
What a large output shows: tiles, small tiles or the one plate.
Shape: from a square plate to a round one, on to six sides and to three.
Open Menu for Guide, audio, Reload or Exit.
Keep shaking the plate. Let go and the sand gathers.
Next preset: n, m and shape slide there together.
Knock the sand away from that spot. It flows back.

sections.title: How it works
sections.text: The plate is always humming and the sand is always moving; K2 only decides whether you hear it. Sand jumps about wherever the plate shakes and comes to rest on the lines where it stands still. n and m choose the figure, and the pitch rises with them. The figures come from tidy formulas chosen for their looks.

sections.title: Audio
sections.text: The App opens silent. K2 starts the note: sine waves with a few overtones, like a bowed plate; with a mode kept there are two notes. Changes of note and loudness glide, and nothing is louder than half of full level.

sections.title: Listen
sections.text: K2 pressed again after Sound is Listen: the App falls silent, opens the microphone or line in, and the plate takes the mode whose note is nearest the one it hears. Sing or play one long note and the figure stands; slide, and the sand flows from figure to figure. What is heard is used for nothing else and is not kept. The input is asked for only once K2 has rested on Listen for a moment, and is given back when you leave it.

sections.title: Large output
sections.text: A large output shows the plate and its sand and nothing else. E3 pressed chooses how: Tiles lays the plate over the whole screen, every other one turned over so that the figure runs on from plate to plate; Small tiles does the same with plates half the size; Plate shows the one plate. The output has grains of its own, so the figure is the same while single grains differ.

sections.title: Saved settings
sections.text: n, m, a kept mode, drive, shape, colours and what the output shows save automatically, and a shared link opens the same figure. Sound and Listen always start off.
